name: Scalp (quick play)
description: A quick momentum play on a young or freshly pushing coin: small size, fast partial profits, a tight trail, a 20-minute clock and a hard stop. Never carried between agent sessions.

fit.summary: Under ~6 h old, or a fresh 5m push on any coin; tape live with buyers; the move is minutes old. Pick scalp when in doubt.
signals: price at or above the 1m VWAP

hardStop.why: A scalp has no thesis beyond the next minutes of momentum: -25% means the read was wrong. It is the smallest size, so the slippage a stop pays costs least here. A rug can still gap through it.

reentry.requires: a new full vet that passes and a new 5m high after the exit

notes: Upgrade to swing or runner only after TP1 filled, the price is above the TP1 level and every thesis check is clean.

1.1.0 adds wake (the judgement calls that wake the position's agent session; noAnswer is what happens when no session answers in time) and maxHoldMinutes (a hard holding cap). Mechanical exits never wait for the session.
